Paper Receipt Shared Gift 033

Four classmates bought a plant for their teacher. Each agreed to give ten yuan. At the shop, the pot they had chosen was unavailable, so they bought a smaller one costing thirty-two yuan. The pupil who paid first kept the receipt. She did not simply collect the planned ten yuan from everyone. She showed the actual cost and divided it equally. Each paid eight yuan. They kept the remaining money rather than buying an extra item without discussing it. The group wrote the plant’s care note on a card, and the receipt stayed in their shared project folder.

Complete all five gaps using the correct one-word form of the given word.
1. Yesterday, our group ____1____ (leave) the hall after returning every tool.
2. The display included three model ____2____ (wolf), each with a different pose.
3. The second route was ____3____ (short) than the long walk around the lake.
4. Look! The children are ____4____ (tie) name tags onto their bags.
5. The guide explained the change ____5____ (calm) when several visitors were confused.
questions.explanation: 接受wolves：three明确复数，wolf变wolves；wolf单数、wolfs本题动物复数错误、wolveses重复复数。
